name: bead-to-prod
description: The carrier-scale reference: the full tracked-work lifecycle from a bead to shipped, at the scale an estate carrier actually runs. run_context seeds (ALL required): 'bead' = the tracked work-item id; 'store' = the issue-store path the intake reads; 'lane' = the repo directory the work lands on. intake reads the bead and commits its acceptance; plan turns acceptance into ordered file-level steps; lane implements and commits on the repo lane; verify re-runs the repo's own suite and is the suite-PROOF node; a when-guarded pair routes on the verify answer — the ok arm asks the owner to publish (publishes node, refused typed at the wave boundary unless the suite proof is banked), the failed arm drops a loud halt note. Swap the beads wording for your tracker CLI to run this elsewhere; do not bolt a bead_close key onto closeout before reading the grammar — its store path is a baked literal, never a {run.KEY}.

nodes.goal: Read work item {run.bead} in the issue store at {run.store} (bd show {run.bead}). Commit what the item actually demands: its title, its acceptance criteria verbatim, and anything it forbids. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"title": "<str>", "acceptance": ["<criterion>", ...], "forbids": ["<str>", ...]}

Turn the acceptance list into an ordered implementation plan: for each step name the exact files it touches and the check that proves it. Honor every forbids entry. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"steps": ["<file-level step>", ...]}

Work the repo lane at {run.lane} for item {run.bead}. Implement the planned steps, keep the diff minimal and honest to the acceptance list, and commit with a message that names the item. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"summary": "<str>", "files": ["<path>", ...]}

Verify the lane work for item {run.bead} at {run.lane}: re-run the repo's own test suite yourself — never trust the implementer's report. Any red or unexplained skip means ok=false. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"ok": true|false, "evidence": "<the command you ran and its tail>"}

nodes.output: VERIFY DIED OR CAME BACK RED — nothing publishes. Read the verify record, fix the lane, re-drive. The halt arm exists so a red verify is a landing, not a silence.

nodes.question: Verify is green for {run.bead}. Publish the lane work? Answer 'publish' to ship it or 'hold' to keep it banked and unshipped.

nodes.goal: Publish the verified lane work for item {run.bead} at {run.lane}: push the branch and open the PR (never merge on this authority). Reply with ONLY fenced json {"pr": "<url>", "result": "<str>"}
